title: Partner Mode v1 Phase 2 hard-gating
problem_statement: HAL dispatch can proceed without explicit acceptance criteria/autonomy boundaries, causing ambiguity and rework risk.
objective: Enforce handoff validation gate before HAL dispatch from all active dispatcher paths.

failure_points: Missing handoff files for active task IDs
Task IDs not matching strict card_ validator
current_state.blast_radius: Medium operational impact: HAL kanban dispatches will skip until handoff contracts exist; proactive dispatch path unaffected.

options_considered.option: Strict block with strict card_ validator
options_considered.tradeoffs: Strong enforcement but incompatible with task_* ids
Strong enforcement + compatibility across id formats

selected_solution.rationale: Best balance of reliability and practicality; enforces contract quality without depending on legacy id format.

guardrails.fallback: If handoff invalid/missing, skip HAL dispatch and post explicit kanban comment.
guardrails.rollback: Remove generic validator and revert dispatch-script gate blocks.

completion.summary: Phase 2 baseline completed: generic handoff validator added and enforced in both HAL dispatch paths; missing/invalid handoffs now block with explicit kanban comment.
